# @loom/middleware

Reference effect middleware for Loom — cross-cutting concerns (retries, and later logging/idempotency/tracing) around effect execution, replay-safe and statically ordered

## Entry points

- `@loom/middleware`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
